stories.title: The Day I Missed My Bus
sentences: Last Monday, I woke up late for college.
My alarm did not ring, and I panicked.
I rushed to get ready in just ten minutes.
I grabbed my bag and ran to the bus stop.
But the bus had already left without me.
I felt so disappointed and worried about being late.
I decided to take an auto-rickshaw instead.
The auto driver drove through busy morning traffic.
We reached college just as the first class began.
My friend saved a seat for me near the window.
I explained what happened, and she laughed kindly.
That day taught me to always set two alarms.
Now I never miss the bus again.

vocabulary.example_sentence: She panicked when she lost her wallet at the station.
He rushed home when he heard the news.

vocabulary.meaning: feeling sad because something did not happen as hoped
vocabulary.example_sentence: She felt disappointed when the trip got cancelled.

stories.title: My First Cooking Disaster
sentences: Last month, I decided to cook dinner for my hostel friends.
I chose a simple recipe for vegetable pasta.
I bought fresh tomatoes, onions, and pasta from the market.
In the kitchen, I chopped the vegetables carefully.
I forgot to add salt because I was distracted.
The pasta turned out bland and a little burnt.
My friends tasted it and tried not to laugh.
One friend honestly said it needed more flavor.
I felt embarrassed but also amused by the situation.
We ordered pizza instead and ate together happily.
I saved the recipe and promised to try again.
The next week, my second attempt was much tastier.
Now cooking is one of my favorite hobbies.

vocabulary.meaning: a set of instructions to prepare a dish
vocabulary.example_sentence: She shared her grandmother's recipe for pickles.

vocabulary.meaning: unable to focus because attention was elsewhere
vocabulary.example_sentence: He was distracted by his phone during the meeting.

stories.title: The Surprise Power Cut
sentences: One hot evening, the electricity suddenly went off in our hostel.
Everyone groaned because the fans stopped working immediately.
I searched for a candle in my study table drawer.
My roommate found an old torch that still worked.
We sat together in the dim light and talked.
Somebody suggested we tell funny stories to pass the time.
We laughed about old memories from our childhood.
Outside, other students gathered in the corridor with candles too.
Someone started singing softly, and others joined in.
After an hour, the power finally returned with a click.
Everyone cheered loudly when the lights came back on.
That unexpected evening became a cherished memory for all of us.

vocabulary.meaning: made a low sound showing pain or annoyance
vocabulary.example_sentence: He groaned when he saw the long queue.
She called the doctor immediately after the accident.
The room looked dim with just one small lamp.

stories.title: A Walk in the Rain
sentences: Yesterday, dark clouds covered the sky in the afternoon.
I decided to take a walk before the rain started.
Suddenly, heavy drops began to fall on the road.
I had no umbrella, so I kept walking anyway.
The cool rain felt refreshing on my tired face.
I passed a small tea stall near the college gate.
The owner offered me a hot cup of tea.
I stood under his shed and sipped the warm tea.
Two strangers joined us, laughing about the sudden rain.
We shared stories while raindrops splashed on the tin roof.
When the rain slowed, I thanked the owner and left.
I walked home slowly, feeling calm and grateful.
That simple evening turned into a memory I still treasure.

vocabulary.example_sentence: A refreshing glass of lemonade helped him beat the heat.

vocabulary.meaning: a small stand for selling goods
vocabulary.example_sentence: We bought fresh fruit from a roadside stall.

Two strangers helped push our car out of the mud.
I am grateful for my friends' support during exams.

stories.title: The Lost Library Book
sentences: Two weeks ago, I borrowed a novel from the college library.
I read it every night before falling asleep.
One morning, I could not find the book anywhere.
I searched my whole room, but it had vanished.
I worried about paying a fine for the lost book.
I asked my roommate if she had seen it.
She remembered I had lent it to another friend.
I called that friend, and she apologized immediately.
She had left it in the canteen by mistake.
Luckily, the canteen staff had kept it safely aside.
I felt relieved when I finally got the book back.
I returned it to the library the very next day.
The librarian smiled and said everything was fine.

vocabulary.meaning: took something to use and return later
vocabulary.example_sentence: He borrowed a pen from his classmate during the test.
The keys vanished from the table without a trace.

stories.title: The Mess Food Mystery
sentences: Every Wednesday, our hostel mess serves a mysterious orange curry.
Nobody knows exactly what vegetables are inside it.
My roommate Aisha calls it the mystery curry.
We always guess the ingredients before taking a bite.
Last week, we decided to ask the cook directly.
The cook laughed and revealed his secret recipe.
It was actually pumpkin, carrot, and a special spice mix.
We were surprised because it tasted better than we expected.
Now our whole floor requests the curry every single week.
The cook feels proud that we enjoy his dish so much.
Aisha still jokingly calls it the mystery curry anyway.
Mess food brings our hostel friends together every day.

vocabulary.example_sentence: A mysterious noise came from the old building at night.

vocabulary.meaning: items used to prepare a dish
vocabulary.example_sentence: She listed all the ingredients needed for the cake.

vocabulary.meaning: made something known that was hidden
vocabulary.example_sentence: The magician revealed his trick at the end of the show.

stories.title: Roommates for Life
sentences: When I first moved into the hostel, I was very nervous.
My roommate Priya greeted me with a warm smile.
She helped me arrange my books and clothes neatly.
At first, we were complete strangers sharing one small room.
Slowly, we started sharing snacks and late-night conversations.
We supported each other during difficult exam weeks.
Priya always listened patiently whenever I felt homesick.
I helped her practice for her college presentations too.
Within a few months, we became inseparable friends.
Other students often said we behaved like sisters.
Even during arguments, we always made up quickly.
Today, Priya is one of my closest friends in life.
I am thankful the hostel paired us together that year.

stories.title: The Midnight Maggi Party
sentences: It was exam week, and everyone in our hostel wing felt stressed.
Around midnight, my friend Rohan knocked softly on my door.
He held a packet of Maggi noodles and a small stove.
Four of us quietly gathered in the common room.
Rohan cooked the noodles while we whispered so nobody would wake up.
The delicious smell of masala filled the whole room.
We ate together, sharing one big bowl with four spoons.
Someone cracked a joke, and we all burst into laughter.
The warden almost caught us, but we hid just in time.
That risky midnight snack broke all our exam stress.
We studied better the next morning, feeling refreshed and happy.
Even now, we remember that night as pure fun.

vocabulary.example_sentence: She felt stressed before her final exams.

stories.title: Two Left Shoes
sentences: On sports day, I woke up in a rush and grabbed my shoes.
I ran to the ground where the race was about to start.
Just before my race, I looked down and gasped.
Both shoes were the left one from two different pairs.
My friend Meera noticed and started giggling uncontrollably.
She quickly offered me her spare pair of sports shoes.
Her shoes were a size too big, but I had no choice.
I ran the race with loose shoes, wobbling at every step.
Somehow, I still finished third in the race.
Everyone in our group laughed about the mismatched shoes for weeks.
Meera still teases me whenever we talk about sports day.
That embarrassing moment became one of our funniest hostel memories.

vocabulary.meaning: took a quick breath in shock or surprise
vocabulary.example_sentence: She gasped when she saw the surprise party.

vocabulary.meaning: laughing in a light, silly way
vocabulary.example_sentence: The children were giggling at the funny cartoon.

vocabulary.meaning: extra, kept for use when needed

stories.title: The Best Farewell Gift
sentences: At the end of final year, our hostel planned a farewell party.
My roommates secretly planned a surprise gift for me.
On the last evening, they called me to the terrace.
I found fairy lights and a handmade photo album waiting there.
The album had pictures from four years of hostel life.
Each photo had a funny handwritten caption beside it.
I felt tears of joy as I turned every page.
My friends had also written heartfelt letters inside the cover.
Priya said the hostel would feel empty without me.
We hugged tightly, promising to stay in touch forever.
That night, we sat under the stars, sharing old memories.
The photo album remains my most precious keepsake today.

vocabulary.meaning: in a way that is hidden from others

vocabulary.meaning: made by hand, not by machine
vocabulary.example_sentence: She gave him a handmade card for his birthday.
He gave a heartfelt speech at the farewell event.
